exact_statement: For every n>=0 and every two quadratic Boolean phases g0,g1 on the same uniform physical n-bit cube, G(z,y)=g_z(y) has selector entropy decrement L=H(G)-(H(g0)+H(g1))/2 <= (12-(9/2)log2(3))*Inf_z(G), and H(G) <= (16/3-(3/2)log2(3))*I(G). Both constants are attained by g0=1 and g1=(-1)^(y0*y1). The admitted distinct-label quadratic affine-row function f(x,z,y)=(-1)^(xz+zy0y1) restricts at x=0 to this witness, so arbitrary label collision does not preserve a conditional constant of two. For X=z,Y=(y0,y1), the witness retains H(S_Y|S_X)=2-(3/8)log2(3) and I_Y=1/2.
